paragraphs.text: The Zendikar block is the sixteenth block consisting of, atypically, two large expansions Zendikar ( ) and Rise of the Eldrazi ( ), with one small expansion Worldwake ( ) in between.

The Zendikar block was released over 2009–2010. In design, it was considered an experimental land block. Because of Rise's premise as a large set, it introduced its own collection of ability words and keywords, instead of further expansion of the previous mechanics.
